decision: The 4-encoder/6-decoder candidate did not replicate its first-seed held-out improvement: seed 1042 gained 3/245 on the pilot subset, lost 5/493 on confirmation, and added 2 execution failures in total. Public bot scores were 102/960 for the 6/4 control and 109/960 for 4/6, but the predeclared held-out gate failed. Keep 6/4 for the next screen; do not start a long depth-change run. The mature 575/960 checkpoint remains the best. A repeated seed-1042 6/4 control varied from an earlier 115/960 to 102/960 despite matching recorded configuration and initial body hash; the cause is not isolated. Small gains remain uncertain.
compute: The complete two-arm driver took 595.30 seconds (9.92 minutes), including dataset restoration, training and evaluation. Whole-driver GPU activity had median 95%, mean 66.19%, and peak memory 21,113 MiB. Both complete model files were downloaded from Drive and checksum-verified.
